name: connect-model-connect-objects-cleanup
description: What: Delete EVERY Connect strategy (template- and portal-built) and every service configuration except 'Profisee File Repository Service Configuration' on the Main instance, so connect-objects-reset recreates them from a clean slate. Never deletes an entity. Portal-built strategies must be rebuilt afterwards. Why: A building block of the Connect pack; a test, setup or schedule workload runs it so its steps exist once. When: Never run directly once the pack is tested; its parents run it. Running it alone is safe only when its own Needs are met. Needs: reference values: connect/urls:ConnectBaseUrl. Success: Every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Run connect-preflight first; then open the first failed step, whose If it fails text names what to check.

inline.description: What: Delete every Connect strategy, then every service configuration except 'Profisee File Repository Service Configuration'. Fails listing anything it could not delete. Why: Does work no single built-in step does (several calls, waits or checks in one place) and stops at the first problem. Success: The script finishes without an error; its output lines say what it did. If it fails: Read the last output line and the error text: the script names the value, server or record it could not handle.
